landing.text:
HEADLINE
Turn client feedback into actionable tasks

SUBHEADLINE
For dev agency owners, client feedback gets lost in Slack, email, and Loom.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps dev agency owners move from client feedback gets lost in slack, email, and loo to turn client feedback into actionable tasks.

WHO IT IS FOR
Dev agency owners

THE PROBLEM
Client feedback gets lost in Slack, email, and Loom

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Linear and Jira was not designed for dev agency owners. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing dev agency owners to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Automates task ticket creation from client feedback.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of Client Feedback Management reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with Client Feedback Management.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Client Feedback Management helps dev agency owners turn client feedback into actionable tasks.

ONBOARDING
1. Connect your Slack account to start collecting client feedback.
2. Set up your first client profile by adding their name and email.
3. Start capturing client feedback in the input field.

EMPTY STATE
1. No client profiles found. Add a new one to get started.
2. No client feedback received yet. Share some with us!
3. Your account is empty. Invite clients or import existing ones.

ERROR
1. Slack connection failed. Check your credentials and try again.
2. Client profile not found. Verify the email address and try again.
3. Feedback input error. Try re-entering the text without formatting.

TOAST
1. Profile set up!
2. Feedback received!
3. Results ready!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Save Profile
2. Add Client
3. Generate Report
4. Edit Settings
5. View Account
6. Start My SIP
7. Complete KYC
8. Build Brain
